trackingBatches.title: Upload batches
trackingBatches.description: Expand a batch to review the orders sent in that upload.
trackingBatches.snapshotNote: These are the original rows sent in this batch. The batch result does not establish the outcome of each individual order.
trackingBatches.empty: No upload batches recorded for this shop. Manually confirmed orders remain in the orders tab.
trackingBatches.search: Search order or tracking in this batch
trackingBatches.detailError: Unable to load orders in this batch
trackingBatches.draftNote: Download this draft and upload it manually in Amazon Seller Central. Downloading does not submit the batch or change confirmation status.
